# 0. Introduction

```{r}
# For each locus, BayeScan calculates a posterior probability (Posterior odds) - available through the parameter pr_odds - for the model including selection. 
# These posterior probabilities indicate how much more likely the model with selection is compared to the neutral model. 
# For instance, a pr_odds of 10 means that there is a 1 in 10 probability for a marker to be under selection. 
# This number would be too high when considering a dataset with up to 10,000 markers.
```

# 1. Install and load libraries

```{r}
# devtools::install_github("thierrygosselin/radiator")

```

# 2. Preparing GESTE (.geste) or BayeScan (.bsc) file

## 2.1. Andrena flavipes dataset (MAF=0.05, FMISS=0.20, NO thinned) - Done with BCFtools + tidypopgen R package

```{r}
Andrena_flavipes_vcf <- read.vcfR("/mnt/data2/Project_Polli_agro/Operational/4_data_analysis/01_snpcall/04_BCFtools/VCF_files_rm_assafora_kinship_GQ20_minDP8_genmiss_bialelic_polyonly/VCF_after_tidypopgen_filtering/AND_stk_rm_assafora_minDP8_GQ20_genmiss_bialelic_polyonly_fmiss_0.20_maf_0.01.vcf.gz.vcf")

Andrena_flavipes_pop_map <- read.table("/mnt/data2/Project_Polli_agro/Operational/2_metadata/02_SSF_samples/01_sample_files/AND_structure_popfile_bayescan.txt", header=TRUE, stringsAsFactors = TRUE)

Andrena_flavipes_genind <- vcfR2genind(Andrena_flavipes_vcf)

Andrena_flavipes_genind@pop <- Andrena_flavipes_pop_map$STRATA

Andrena_flavipes_hierfstat <- genind2hierfstat(Andrena_flavipes_genind)

write.bayescan(Andrena_flavipes_hierfstat)
```

# 4. MCMC Check

```{r}
# function to read the .sel file
read_sel_file <- function(path) {
  header <- readLines(path, n = 1) %>% 
    str_split(" ") %>% unlist()
  header <- c("Step", header[1:(length(header)-1)])
  df <- read.delim(path, sep = "", header = F, skip = 1, col.names = header)
  return(df)
}

# read .sel file
bombus_sel <- read_sel_file("Lasioglossum_malachurum_results/Lasioglossum_malachurum_minDP8_GQ20_genmiss_bialelic_polyonly_fmiss_0.20_maf_0.05_tidypopgen.sel")

# convert ot coda object
bombus_sel_coda <- coda::mcmc(bombus_sel[,c(-1,-2)], thin = 10)

# calculate effective sample size (measure of sample autocorrelation)
# we want our MCMC samples to be independent
# ideally ESS = actual number of samples
effectiveSize(bombus_sel_coda)

# chain convergence diagnostic
heidel.diag(bombus_sel_coda)

# plot the traceplots/density plots of sampled parameters
plot(bombus_sel_coda)
```

# 5. Gathering and cleaning results
## 5.1. gathering raw results

```{r}
# read _fst.txt file generated from bayescan run
Lasioglossum_malachurum_bayescan=read.table("Lasioglossum_malachurum_results/Lasioglossum_malachurum_minDP8_GQ20_genmiss_bialelic_polyonly_fmiss_0.20_maf_0.05_tidypopgen_fst.txt")

# get information from .vcf file
Lasioglossum_malachurum_vcf <- readLines("/mnt/data2/Project_Polli_agro/Operational/4_data_analysis/01_snpcall/04_BCFtools/VCF_files_rm_assafora_kinship_GQ20_minDP8_genmiss_bialelic_polyonly/VCF_after_tidypopgen_filtering/LML_stk_rm_assafora_minDP8_GQ20_genmiss_bialelic_polyonly_fmiss_0.20_maf_0.05.vcf.gz.vcf")

# get IDs from .vcf file
Lasioglossum_malachurum_ids <- Lasioglossum_malachurum_vcf[!grepl("^#", Lasioglossum_malachurum_vcf)]
Lasioglossum_malachurum_ids <- strsplit(Lasioglossum_malachurum_ids, "\t")
Lasioglossum_malachurum_ids <- vapply(Lasioglossum_malachurum_ids, `[`, character(1), 3)

writeLines(Lasioglossum_malachurum_ids, "Lasioglossum_malachurum_results/Lasioglossum_malachurum_maf0.05_SNPs_id.txt")

# Preparing a raw table with results
SNPb=read.table("Lasioglossum_malachurum_results/Lasioglossum_malachurum_maf0.05_SNPs_id.txt",header=FALSE)

bayescan=cbind(SNPb, Lasioglossum_malachurum_bayescan)

colnames(bayescan)=c("SNP","PROB","LOG_PO","Q_VALUE","ALPHA","FST")

write.table(bayescan, "Lasioglossum_malachurum_results/Lasioglossum_malachurum_pr100_maf_0.05_fmiss_0.20_GQ_20_MIN_DP_8_no_thinned_tidypopgen_results.txt", quote=FALSE, sep="\t", row.names=FALSE)
```

## 5.2. cleaning results and tagging the outliers as *neutral*, *balancing*, *positive*

```{r}
attach(bayescan)
class(bayescan$Q_VALUE)

bayescan$Q_VALUE <- as.numeric(bayescan$Q_VALUE) 
bayescan[bayescan$Q_VALUE<=0.0001,"Q_VALUE"]=0.0001

bayescan$LOG_PO <- (round(bayescan$LOG_PO, 4)) 
bayescan$Q_VALUE <- (round(bayescan$Q_VALUE, 4)) 
bayescan$ALPHA <- (round(bayescan$ALPHA, 4)) 
bayescan$FST <- (round(bayescan$FST, 6))

bayescan$SELECTION <- ifelse(bayescan$ALPHA>=0&bayescan$Q_VALUE<=0.05,"diversifying",ifelse(bayescan$ALPHA>=0&bayescan$Q_VALUE>0.05,"neutral","balancing")) 
bayescan$SELECTION<- factor(bayescan$SELECTION)
levels(bayescan$SELECTION) 

positive <- bayescan[bayescan$SELECTION=="diversifying",] 
neutral <- bayescan[bayescan$SELECTION=="neutral",] 
balancing <- bayescan[bayescan$SELECTION=="balancing",]
```

# 6. Writting tables with outlliers

```{r}
# number of outliers per class (balancing, neutral, or positive)
xtabs(data=bayescan, ~SELECTION)

# min(qvalue) and max(qvalue)
range(bayescan$Q_VALUE)

#log10 qvalue transformation
bayescan$LOG10_Q <- -log10(bayescan$Q_VALUE)

# writting tables with outlliers
write.table(neutral, "Lasioglossum_malachurum_results/Lasioglossum_malachurum_pr_100_maf_0.05_fmiss_0.20_GQ_20_no_thinned_tidypopgen_neutral.txt", row.names=F, quote=F)
write.table(balancing, "Lasioglossum_malachurum_results/Lasioglossum_malachurum_pr_100_maf_0.05_fmiss_0.20_GQ_20_no_thinned_tidypopgen_balancing.txt", row.names=F, quote=F)
write.table(positive, "Lasioglossum_malachurum_results/Lasioglossum_malachurum_pr_100_maf_0.05_fmiss_0.20_GQ_20_no_thinned_tidypopgen_positive.txt", row.names=F, quote=F)
```

# 8. Generating outlier tables with CHR and POS
## 8.1. Function to add CHR and POS from a VCF to an outlier table

```{r}
add_vcf_info_to_outliers <- function(outlier_file, vcf_file, output_file) {
  
  # read outlier table
  outliers <- read.table(outlier_file, header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  
  # read VCF as lines
  vcf_lines <- readLines(vcf_file)
  
  # keep only variant lines
  vcf_records <- vcf_lines[!grepl("^#", vcf_lines)]
  vcf_records <- strsplit(vcf_records, "\t")
  
  # build metadata table from VCF
  vcf_info <- data.frame(
    CHR = vapply(vcf_records, `[`, character(1), 1),
    POS = as.numeric(vapply(vcf_records, `[`, character(1), 2)),
    SNP = vapply(vcf_records, `[`, character(1), 3),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  # join by SNP ID
  outliers_with_vcf <- left_join(outliers, vcf_info, by = "SNP")
  
  # optional: move CHR and POS after SNP
  outliers_with_vcf <- outliers_with_vcf %>%
    select(SNP, CHR, POS, everything())
  
  # save
  write.table(
    outliers_with_vcf,
    output_file,
    quote = FALSE,
    sep = "\t",
    row.names = FALSE
  )
  
  return(outliers_with_vcf)
}
```
